description: This source file defines an internal static class 'NonCapturingTimer' that provides a method to create a Timer instance while suppressing the capturing of the ExecutionContext, thus avoiding the rooting of AsyncLocals. It serves as a utility for safer timer creation in asynchronous environments.

classes.name: NonCapturingTimer
classes.description: A static utility class providing a method to create timers that do not capture the ExecutionContext.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new Timer that executes a callback after a due time and then periodically, without capturing the current ExecutionContext to avoid retaining AsyncLocals.
